meta.name: analyzing-linux-audit-logs-for-intrusion
meta.description: Uses the Linux Audit framework (auditd) with ausearch and aureport utilities to detect intrusion attempts, unauthorized access, privilege escalation, and suspicious system activity. Covers audit rule configuration, log querying, timeline reconstruction, and integration with SIEM platforms. Activates for requests involving auditd analysis, Linux audit log investigation, ausearch queries, aureport summaries, or host-based intrusion detection on Linux.

copy.tagline: 分析 Linux 审计日志发现入侵痕迹
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要从 Linux 审计日志中找出可疑活动或入侵证据。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze Linux audit logs to detect intrusion traces
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to find suspicious activity or intrusion evidence from Linux audit logs.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能分析 Linux 审计日志，检测入侵尝试、未授权访问、权限提升和可疑系统活动。它会指导你配置审计规则、查询日志、重建攻击时间线，并集成 SIEM 平台。
howto.when: 当你请求分析 auditd 日志、调查 Linux 审计日志、使用 ausearch 或 aureport 查询，或进行基于主机的入侵检测时触发。

say.note: Claude 会使用 ausearch 查询相关事件。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can analyze Linux audit logs to detect intrusion attempts, unauthorized access, privilege escalation, and suspicious system activity. It guides you in configuring audit rules, querying logs, reconstructing attack timelines, and integrating with SIEM platforms.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you request auditd analysis, Linux audit log investigation, ausearch queries, aureport summaries, or host-based intrusion detection on Linux.

say_en.text: Analyze failed login events from the past week.

say_en.text: Reconstruct the attack timeline from 14:00 to 18:00 yesterday.
